display_duration.description: Fallback seconds on the panel; the plugin reports its own length from page_seconds and the alert count

weather_entity.description: Any HA weather entity (it must support hourly and daily forecasts)

alerts_entity.description: NWS Alerts sensor whose Alerts attribute lists the active alerts

alerts.description: Show a page for each active weather alert, first in the rotation, and a warning badge on the Now page

interrupt_alerts.description: Take over the panel when a new alert appears (ha-notifications may already do this through MQTT)

hourly_step.description: Hours between the six hourly columns

detail_tiles.description: Up to four tiles for the details page (default wind, humidity, uv, rain)

poll_seconds.description: Seconds between polls of current conditions and alerts

latitude.description: Override Home Assistant's location (sunrise and Moon are computed for this place)

timezone.description: Override Home Assistant's time zone, e.g. America/New_York

radar.description: Animated precipitation radar page (RainViewer over a map), shown once its frames have loaded

radar_range_miles.description: Miles from the centre of the map to the edge of the panel

radar_seconds.description: Seconds the radar page stays up; 0 = two loops of the animation (between page_seconds and 30)

radar_update_interval.description: Seconds between checks for newer radar frames

radar_tile_server.description: Optional OSM-style tile server tried first when radar_map_style is osm

radar_map_brightness.description: Dim the map so the radar stands out

radar_show_nowcast.description: Append RainViewer short-term forecast frames to the loop

radar_smooth.description: Crossfade between radar frames so the rain moves like video; off steps through the frames one by one

radar_loop_pause_seconds.description: Pause on the newest frame before the loop restarts

test_mode.description: Play a made-up day: a time-lapse of the sky with a storm, then every page and two alerts. Turn off afterwards.
